angular_project_generator_app_ang_node_n: Node.js ranges come from angular.dev's official compatibility table for each major, not from this app's own toolchain.
angular_project_generator_app_ang_versio: Every Angular major from 14 to 22 is a real generation target: its own builder, bootstrap strategy, SSR package and capability set. Only Angular 22 has an executed build behind it — this repository is one. Older majors are modeled from Angular's published compatibility data, not run here.
angular_project_generator_app_arch_custo: Custom lets you name every bucket yourself — core, shared, layout, and the folder that groups your domains or features — instead of accepting one of the other three fixed contracts. Reach for it when your team already has a folder convention and the generator should follow it rather than the other way round.
angular_project_generator_app_arch_ddd_h: Domain-driven groups code by what it means to the business, not by its technical type. Each domain owns its full stack — model, use case, repository, component — so a change to one domain rarely touches another. Best for a project with several distinct areas that will each keep growing.
angular_project_generator_app_arch_featu: Feature-based gives every feature its own self-contained folder — pages, components, services and models together — without the four-layer split DDD asks for. Best when features are the natural unit of the product and rarely share deep logic with one another.
angular_project_generator_app_arch_simpl: Simple keeps everything in one flat app folder — pages, components, services, models — with no per-slice grouping at all. Best for a small, focused project where a folder-per-domain or folder-per-feature split would be overhead, not structure.
angular_project_generator_app_ca_resp_d: Shared breakpoints, used by every component.
angular_project_generator_app_ca_rtl_d: Direction-aware helpers plus font overrides for RTL.
angular_project_generator_app_ca_tokens_: Radius, spacing and breakpoint maps in _tokens.scss.
angular_project_generator_app_ca_vars_d: Every colour is a custom property, scoped per theme.
angular_project_generator_app_cjk_note: Chinese uses a system font stack. Self-hosting a full CJK face would break the source project's performance budget.
angular_project_generator_app_core_auth_: Login/logout, a token-aware interceptor and an auth guard. Requires Storage.
angular_project_generator_app_core_authz: Role checks, a role guard and a structural directive. Requires Authentication.
angular_project_generator_app_core_cap_d: Each one resolves to a real, generated implementation — the same template system as Toast, Modal and Date picker above.
angular_project_generator_app_core_err_d: A global ErrorHandler plus HTTP error mapping, normalized to one AppError shape.
angular_project_generator_app_core_http_: A typed HttpClient wrapper with centralized error normalization. Requires Error handling.
angular_project_generator_app_core_routi: Typed path building and query-param helpers.
angular_project_generator_app_core_store: SSR-safe localStorage + cookie persistence, prefixed per project.
angular_project_generator_app_csr_json_l: With browser-only rendering, structured data is written after hydration and some crawlers will not see it. Allowed, but worth a decision before you ship.
angular_project_generator_app_css_arch_d: These come with the architecture template. They are not separate switches.
angular_project_generator_app_cust_not_a: Copying a template requires a modern (standalone-components) Angular version.
angular_project_generator_app_date_picke: A popover calendar picker with keyboard support — generator-authored, since no source-project template exists for this one.
angular_project_generator_app_ddd_d: core / domains / shared / layout, with a four-layer slice per domain.
angular_project_generator_app_dual_mode_: The source project ships both, switchable at runtime.
